name: How long does a resurfaced deck typically last?

mainEntity.name: How long does a resurfaced deck typically last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a resurfaced deck depends heavily on the quality of materials used, the skill of the installation, and ongoing maintenance. A well-executed resurfacing project using durable materials and proper sealing can extend your deck's life significantly, often for another 5-15 years or more. Regular cleaning and reapplication of protective finishes are crucial for longevity. Hometelligent Inc. provides guidance on maintenance practices to help maximize the life of your resurfaced deck in areas like San Leandro and Hayward.
acceptedAnswer.description: A well-resurfaced deck can last 5-15+ years with quality materials and regular maintenance, including cleaning and re-sealing.
